880-3585-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3585-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1669-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1669-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

5170-6132-6797-8175.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

789-2738-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

670-1619-3991-6137.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6137.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Barrowin of Clan Undurr from exile to the battlefield.
When Barrowin of Clan Undurr enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Barrowin of Clan Undurr trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

3259-4766-6233-7708--166.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4766-6233-7708--166.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ardenn triggers, attaching Breath of Fury and Deathrender to the creature with haste.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to Ares, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Ares and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ares trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-7668.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Lignify by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Medomai and causing it to lose its abilities.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Lignify and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

725-1432-2436.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Marwyn and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2149-2440-3992.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Zaffai
1618-2149-2440-3992.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Cyclical Evolution.
Cyclical Evolution triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Zaffai triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Cyclical Evolution.
Repeat.
1618-2149-2440-3992.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Zaffai. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1558-3875-4231-4365-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-4365-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-2604-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1978-4002-4241.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-4241.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Karn.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2034-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2034-2363-4985-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3875-5702--131.manaNeeded: {2}{G} plus enough mana to animate the land
3875-5702--131.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5702--131.description:
Animate the land.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated land.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

1879-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-2366-4826-5184-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2366-4826-5184-6413.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1329-2178-2921-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2921-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2092-3680-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Stunt Double and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
2092-3680-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Stunt Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Stunt Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Stunt Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Stunt Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Stunt Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

413-708-2210-2459.notablePrerequisites: Mirrormade is a copy of Myth Unbound.
413-708-2210-2459.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

708-2459-2500-5256.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 3, accomplishing nothing.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1223-5147.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-5147.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing that much damage to any target(s).

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that untaps a Creature

5534--28.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least two spells this turn.
Stella Lee does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery card.
You have additional legal target(s) for the instant or sorcery card, if applicable.
5534--28.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Stella Lee by tapping it, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery, untapping Stella Lee.
Repeat from step 2.

4396-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

654-1993-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
654-1993-3525-3756.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

215-1418-2972-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-1418-2972-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and use Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

132-3053-4222.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
132-3053-4222.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

262-3386-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Nurturing Presence attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of one or greater.
262-3386-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental token(s) enter the battlefield, Devoted Druid triggers that many times, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn for each creature that entered the battlefield.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
If Devoted Druid has a power of two or greater, Devoted Druid becomes infinitely large until end of turn, which allows you to use its mana ability instead to get infinite {G}.

3362-4089.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2178-3343-3490-4659-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{B} plus an additional {1} for each other creature you control
2178-3343-3490-4659-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Aron.
Aron does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures.
2178-3343-3490-4659-4871.description:
Activate Aron by paying {W}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
The creature dies, triggering Aron and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Aron trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Aron ability from step 1, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
The Servo dies, triggering Aron and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Aron trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 10 through 13 until you only control one Servo.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{B}.
Repeat.

1802-2060-4120-4498.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, causing all damage that would be dealt this turn to you or to permanents you control to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Gideon's Sacrifice redirects damage to Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing at least one +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2060-4772-5105.manaNeeded: {4} in at least three different colors
2034-2060-4772-5105.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler giving it six +1/+1 counters because of Doubling Season.
Remove all six counters getting {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Sacrifice Crawler to Altar generating {2}.
Pay Sigil's cost of {1}{W} returning Crawler to hand.
Recast Crystalline Crawler for all but one of the remaining floating mana giving it eight +1/+1 counters.
Remove all eight counters netting {8} of assorted colors containing at least {W} {W} {U} {B} {R} {G}.
Repeat steps 4-7.

2062-3356.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.
2062-3356.notes: This combo will result in a mandatory infinite loop. Left unchecked, this will cause the game to end in a draw.
